title: Vasaloppet Tempo Training - Base Building

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slowly arch and round spine, focus on spinal mobility

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Sit with both legs at 90 degrees, rotate hips smoothly between sides

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Pull band apart with straight arms, squeeze shoulder blades together

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Easy pace, focus on form and warming up core and shoulders

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Tempo pace - RPE 7-8, maintain consistent stroke rate and power output

items.name: Rowing Machine
items.cues: Tempo pace - strong leg drive, engage core, maintain rhythm at RPE 7-8

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold stretch gently, feel lengthening in calf and achilles

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place palm on wall, slowly turn away to stretch biceps and chest

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Very easy pace for recovery, focus on deep breathing and relaxation

rationale: Ski erg focus builds specific movement patterns and endurance needed for Vasaloppet 90km race preparation
Tempo intervals at RPE 7-8 develop lactate threshold crucial for sustained race pace over long distances
After extended rest period, gradual return to training with manageable volume while maintaining quality intensity
